title: Assistants API calls stopped working after the 2026-08-26 shutdown
symptoms: Requests to /v1/assistants, /v1/threads and thread runs fail where they used to succeed
client.beta.assistants and client.beta.threads code from tutorials fails on every call
cause: OpenAI shut the Assistants API down on 2026-08-26. Its replacements are the Responses API for generation and the Conversations API for stored state.
fix: Move runs to responses.create and threads to conversations. Keep assistant settings such as model, tools and instructions in your own code rather than in reusable prompts (v1/prompts), because OpenAI set reusable prompts (v1/prompts) to shut down on 2026-11-30.
affected: OpenAI Assistants API, shut down 2026-08-26; OpenAI set reusable prompts (v1/prompts), Evals and Agent Builder to shut down on 2026-11-30
